findings.title: Citation verifier and conflict detector ignore numbers preceded by a letter or dot (e.g. 'Rs.500'), so an unsupported number survives verify
Redaction name matching still misses common OTP/CVV/PIN/password field names (F5 repair incomplete), in both Python and in-page JS
After an answered question, Stop then a new grant leaves Ask permanently disabled (introduced by the F4 UI repair)
In-page snapshot layer does not mask title, headings, labels, placeholders or URL path; docs claim AC7 'MET in both layers'
Derived answers stay retrievable after Stop (revoke)
Bare domain names from untrusted sources survive verify and the extractive path and are rendered
In-page visible() keeps some visually hidden text forms
Research time budget is not checked during the search and feed phases
UI keeps showing an expired grant as ACTIVE
Screenshot capture is not bound to the granted target (only capture() is)
Redaction still misses lowercase run-together OTP/CVV/PIN/password field names (R1-02 class not closed), in both Python and in-page JS
Space-grouped thousands defeat the number check: claim '2 000 000' is supported by source '2 000'
assist_ask captures the screenshot before the vision gate's qualified/debounce/Brain-busy checks
Stop while an Ask is in flight leaves the revoked scope's observation summary, which shows again after the next Share
Records misstate the R1 candidate and provider env names
Redaction still misses run-together OTP/CVV/PIN and token/secret field names (R2-01 class not closed), in both Python and the in-page JS; values reach the Brain request
The NAT64 local-use prefix 64:ff9b:1::/48 is assumed to embed IPv4 in the last 32 bits, and its early return skips the is_global check
Web research Brain synthesis does not yield to a user turn that starts during it; the worker cancels only Assist
The frozen-core ALLOWED_NEW list was not extended for files added by the repair commits
Redaction still misses run-together API-key names and alphanumeric 2FA recovery codes in both Python and the in-page JS (R3-01 token/secret class not closed); values reach the Brain request
Citation verifier and conflict detector ignore magnitude suffixes (m/bn/k/M, lakh/crore, trillion), so a claim with a different magnitude survives verify
SafeFetcher total timeout and cancellation are not enforced while response headers or chunk framing arrive; a hostile server can hold a fetch (and the single research job) far beyond the budget
Local-use NAT64 64:ff9b:1::/48 decoded as /96, so addresses embedding a private IPv4 at the /48 position are accepted
R1-05 still present: derived answers remain retrievable after Stop; a revoke that races the end of an answer still emits it
Screenshot and DOM capture run before the vision and Brain-busy gates; vision context text is not wrapped as an untrusted data block
Only oi_turn cancels Assist Brain work; oi_confirm/oi_decide and in-flight web_research Brain calls do not yield the single slot
Remaining R1 LOW findings (R1-05..R1-10) are neither repaired nor recorded as carried limitations; the audit trail has no R2/R3 entries

Citation verifier and conflict detector mis-parse Indian lakh/crore digit grouping, space-grouped thousands and minus signs, so a claim with a different amount survives verify (R1-01/R4-02 class not closed)

Redaction misses common API-key formats (Stripe sk_live_/rk_live_, GitHub github_pat_, GitLab glpat-, npm_, hf_, SendGrid SG.) and Authorization/TAN fields in both layers; values reach the Brain request (documented residual risk L-A0-2)
Derived answers remain retrievable after Stop (R1-05 not repaired)
DNS resolution is outside the SafeFetcher total deadline and cancel check
Bare domain names and phone numbers from untrusted sources survive verify (R1-06 not repaired)
In-page snapshot keeps height:0/overflow:hidden and color:transparent text, though its comment says transparent text is skipped (R1-07 not repaired)
Citation verifier and conflict detector treat ISO/slash dates as unordered number sets, so a claim with a swapped date survives verify and two sources with different dates are not a conflict
Redaction still misses OTP values with a space and card-security-code fields named CVD/CSV, in Python and the in-page JS; the values reach the Brain request (R1-02..R4-01 class not closed)

Conflict statements and source titles are rendered from raw page text, bypassing the instruction-like and link/contact filters, so www. links, e-mail addresses and injected instructions reach the research surface
HTML extraction keeps several hidden-text forms (W1-AC6)
Instruction flags and data-block delimiters can be defeated with zero-width or lookalike characters, and title newlines inject lines
Bare domains in untrusted text survive verify and the extractive path (R1-06 not repaired); a supported sentence can carry an appended domain
UI keeps showing an expired (or target-lost) grant as ACTIVE even after the worker refuses with SCOPE_NOT_ACTIVE (R1-09 not repaired)
After a worker replacement the Assist picker shows every adapter as unavailable until the app restarts (latent: all adapters are UNAVAILABLE in this build)
Derived answers stay retrievable after Stop (R1-05 not repaired)
check_url runs its literal and numeric-host checks before IDNA mapping, so full-width digit hosts pass the URL policy (refused only at resolution)
Redaction misses the 'CV2' card security code field name (UK/Visa term) in Python and the in-page JS; the value reaches the Brain request (R6-02 class not closed)
Citation verifier and conflict detector ignore numbers written as words, so a claim with a different spelled-out number survives verify (R1-01 class)
Citation verifier and conflict detector ignore the currency, so '$500' is 'supported' by 'Rs 500' and two sources with different currencies are not a conflict
Derived answers stay retrievable after Stop (R1-05 still present)
L-W1-4 still states the total fetch deadline can overrun by the read timeout, which the R4-03 watchdog removed
